constraints: all theorem binders introduced before proof tactics
unique local names, at most 32 characters
only local equality premises/IH as proof references
IH and successor variable exist only in successor branch
no old induction-target variable in either branch
EOS only after a complete grammatical body
constraint_inputs: theorem binder counts and generated prefix only; no reference proof, informal argument, seed ID, family, goal state, or compiler feedback
strategy: The model chooses whether/where to induct, tactics, rewrite direction, local naming, and termination; constraints do not check goals or force successful proof steps.
inference_gate: Before inference, require all 30 reference bodies and their tokenizer paths to be allowed, adversarial syntax/scope checks to pass, and pinned source hashes to match the saved preflight.
comparison: Saved short_3shot development outputs; full 30 seeds and frozen common 25-seed subset, both conditions separately and pooled.
fidelity: Same mathematical-argument rubric as the development audit; manual assistant reviews, not independent human review. Keep the existing structure proxy separate.
success: More verified faithful proofs on the common 25-seed subset (pooled two conditions); report each condition separately. Fewer parser errors without this improvement is not success.
failure_policy: No retry, fallback, or completion repair. Record exceptions and budget-truncated outputs as attempts and send their available text through the unchanged verifier.
